stem: How did the author's ability to concentrate on origami in paragraph 6 influence the plot?

options.label: A
options.text: She replaced her anxiety about a problem with her attention to making origami.

options.label: B
options.text: She automatically folded paper into origami without having to think about it.

options.label: C
options.text: She remembered how to make origami when she saw her favorite color of paper.

options.label: D
options.text: She understood that working carefully was the way to successfully make origami.
